prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create one photorealistic G.Design Ződ interior adaptation of A902 Cam_12.
Image 1: exact apartment camera/geometry edit target. Image 2: newly designed A902 Ződ Cam_02 for the SAME room, governs furniture/textile/table identity. Images 3 and 4: original GD111 photos 04 and 07 for kitchen/dining appearance only.
Use Cam_12 v3, the level southeast-looking hero from the northwest corner, 22 mm at 1.60 m with the locked downward shift. The front of the sofa forms a modest foreground, approximately 16–23 percent of the image. Dining and the ML04 pendant lead into the kitchen; W03 and the existing grey 05.3 door sit beyond, W02 is the major designed wall and W07 returns at the right edge. The TV wall and terrace are behind the camera and remain outside this view.
Preserve image 1 crop, perspective, floor and plank direction, white heated/cooled ceiling and soffits, actual grey doors, ventilation grilles, switches, outlets, wall edges and passage clearances. Do not transfer reference architecture, indoor tree, floor opening, new island or timber ceiling. TV wall and terrace are behind camera and MUST NOT appear here. Preserve kitchen runs, tall refrigerator location, sink, hob and stacked ovens and cabinet opening grid.
Apply original reference heavily flowing emerald/olive/white veined polished stone to the existing kitchen worktops, backsplash and existing peninsula end ONLY. All lower and tall kitchen fronts medium-dark matte brown oak matching new room image 2; upper fronts matte charcoal. Replace brown stone oven-tower face with same dark oak. Hardware slender matte black; preserve appliance type. No new ceiling extractor or ceiling fittings. Concealed warm worktop lighting under existing uppers.
Dining is matte brown oak rectangular top, dark fluted pedestal supports and EXACTLY same taupe upholstered bronze tube wraparound chairs as image 2, in existing dining positions; keep chair count in image 1. Replace pearl pendant with a restrained cluster of three black wire cage shades from one canopy at the same existing ceiling outlet, in the same design language as image 2.
Foreground sofa is EXACTLY the new image-2 grey woven thick modular quilted sofa, same cushion seams, low back and furniture position as geometry target; no cream boucle. The coffee table is EXACTLY the new image-2 rectangular charcoal table, same curved broad supports, grey bowl, green glass vase and two books; keep geometry-target table position and same pale grey rug. Do not invent a second coffee table.
Existing large right artwork rectangle becomes one framed abstract botanical artwork with charcoal background, muted olive plant forms and stone-grey relief texture; same rectangle and thin dark frame. This is apartment-specific art, not original G.Design authorship. Existing right storage remains same height, depth, doors and layout, refinished dark brown oak with slim black handles, small installation joint to actual ceiling. No changes to adjacent openings.
Layered readable evening light 2700 K, real material colours, light under kitchen cupboards and selected existing furniture edges, no ceiling coves, spots, tracks or new electrical points. White ceiling unmodified. Photorealism, straight verticals, same landscape aspect as image 1, no watermark/text/people/collage. This is a concept, not metric/electrical/price verification; no hidden change to HUF18M+2M reserve budget.
